To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a branch and cut method that can solve to optimality instances with up to 100 customers, and that the asymmetric representative formulation is superior to the other formulations.
the 2 index and asymmetric representatives formulations outperform the 3 index formulation and that the addition of the different families of valid cuts improves the LP relaxations.

the 3 index formulation is the best performing formulation, that the asymmetric representatives formulation is the best for the cases where the vehicles are not allowed to return to the depot, and that adding all the valid inequalities proposed in this paper improves the performance of the branch and cut algorithm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new branch and cut algorithm that can solve instances of a multi pickup and delivery vehicle routing problem with time windows to proven optimality.
the development of exact methods for the MPDTPW.
the development of a novel branch and cut algorithm for the multi pickup and deliver with time windows (MPTDW).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
all the formulations presented in this work are very competitive.
the asymmetric representatives formulation is the best one to solve the MPDPTWs exactly, while the 2 index and 3 index formulations are the most suitable ones to solve the MPDPWs heuristically.
the asymmetric representative formulation is the best choice to solve the MPDPTWP.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we were able to solve 41 instances that were not solved before.

we were able to improve the performance of the 3 index formulation by adding new preprocessing rules and valid inequalities, we were able to prove optimality for instances containing up to twice the size of the instances solved by the existing algorithms and finally we introduced two new formulations that are able to solve instances containing up to four times the number of clients than the instances solved by existing algorithms.

we were able to solve 100 new instances to optimality, we were able to improve the best known solutions for 11 instances from the benchmark set and we also improved the best known solution for 1 instance from the literature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 2 index formulations outperform all other formulations.
our branch and cut algorithm is able to prove optimality for instances with up to 100 clients, while the existing heuristic and exact algorithms are able to prove optimally only up to 50 clients.
we are able to prove the optimality of 25 instances that have never been solved before.
